text:
Nick (AE): FYI starting POC with Vanguard Health. They want a 90m soak: sustained 700 qps, avg output 256 tokens, p99 < 180ms, error <1%. Need run plan, sizing, and quick cost delta for adding burst nodes + multi-az.
Talia (SE): got it. Need prompt length distro and percent streaming vs full. Any TL;DR on cacheable prompts?
Nick (AE): about 50% streaming, ~35% highly repeatable prompts (good for KV cache).
Talia (SE): Proposed plan: warmup 10m, ramp 10m to 700 qps, 90m steady, 10m cooldown. Arrival model: Poisson + random microbursts: 4% of windows spike to 3x for 20s. Run models: rwd-7b-q4, rwd-13b-q4, rwd-20b-q4. Enable KV prefix cache and first-token streaming.
Talia (SE): sample load cmd:
```
rwd-load --model rwd-13b-q4 --target-qps 700 --duration 7200 --ramp 600 --warmup 600 --burst-profile "random:4%:20s@3x" --concurrency 100 --payload-dist vanguard_prompts.json
```
Omar (SRE): infra rec: Dedicated pool sized for 840 qps headroom (20%). Autoscale min=1, max=3 nodes, cooldown 90s. Multi-AZ for demo. Fallback policy: 13b->7b to preserve latency. Pre-populate KV during ramp to avoid cold-miss tail.
Priya (Solutions): pricing quickballpark: Dedicated pool for rwd-13b-q4 to sustain 700 qps ~ $1,400/hr. 90m run + warmup ~ $2.1k. Multi-AZ + burst node adds ~18% premium. Hosted token billing rough: $0.20 / 1k inferred tokens (estimate).
load-bot: quick smoke run:
```json
{"test":"vanguard-smoke-2026-03-22","sustained_qps":705,"p50_ms":38,"p95_ms":92,"p99_ms":195,"error_rate_pct":0.7,"gpu_util_pct":83,"notes":"p99 195ms - above 180ms target. Try +15% pool or reduce batch_delay to 5ms."}
```
Talia (SE): p99 195ms — close but over. Fastest action: spin +15% capacity then rerun 30m steady. Alternative: drop max_batch_delay to 5ms for this route (trade higher GPU ops).
Omar (SRE): I'll provision +15% nodes now and schedule a 30m validation in 45m. If still >180ms, we try batch_delay change.
Priya (Solutions): I'll prepare two pricing lines for the customer: (A) baseline with +15% pool (adds ~$210/hr) (B) model fallback to 7b with quality notes. Also compiling security questionnaire snippets to confirm SOC items.
Nick (AE): acceptance criteria: sustained 700 qps, p99 <180ms, <1% errors for 90m. If validation passes, schedule customer soak + demo. Thanks team! :rocket:
